title: observability: token-kv metrics + tracing dashboard + alert tuning
author: Alex Kim
ci_checks: ci/unit-tests: failed on first run (flaky test TestKVCacheStats), rerun -> passed
description:
Adds token-level KV cache metrics, improved tracing spans for KV lookup/merge, a Grafana dashboard for token-level cost/latency breakdowns (host and KV contributions), and tuned alerts to reduce noise after rollout. Motivation: current dashboards aggregated cost/latency at request-level which obscures KV cache effectiveness and per-token cost contributions, making it hard to identify regressions and tune batching/quantization heuristics. This PR: 1) emits new Prometheus metrics: redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_misses_total, redwood_kv_lookup_latency_seconds_bucket, redwood_token_cost_bytes_total (per-model label), and redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket (per-model, per-route). 2) augments tracing by adding explicit spans for KV lookup, KV fetch, and KV merge with total and self durations, and tags for cache_hit/level/size. 3) ships a Grafana dashboard JSON (observability/token-kv-token-cost-latency.json) with panels for token-level cost breakdown (host compute vs kv fetch), KV hit-rate heatmap by model/route, percentile latency by token position, and an example alerting panel. 4) updates alerting rules: lower sensitivity on transient tail latencies, add a multi-criteria alert for sustained token-cost/week-over-week increases, and add a suppression window for deployment rollouts to reduce noise. 5) adds unit and integration tests for metric names and tracing annotations. Checklist:
- [x] Add Prometheus metrics and exporters
- [x] Add tracing spans and tags
- [x] Add Grafana dashboard and dashboard helper script
- [x] Add alerting rules and document tuning rationale
- [x] Tests and CI adjustments

Notes on rollout: metrics are backward compatible (new metric names only), dashboards are additive. Alerts default to muted for 48h after rollout via a deployment annotation to avoid false positives during canary. Related: ENG-4823 (metric runway), ENG-4850 (KV cache improvements).
